variant.briefing:
Hi, 

We’re a little shorthanded at one of our outposts and could use some help. We need someone to gather supplies spread across a few buildings and bring them to one spot.

Here’s what needs to be gathered:

Pick up package #[Item1] at [Location].
Pick up package #[Item4] at [Location].
Pick up package #[Item5] at [Location1].
Pick up package #[Item2] at [Location1].
Pick up package #[Item3] at [Location2].
  
Each one needs to end up at [Destination]. Simple enough, right?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
